# Spring book sale

St Anne's Hall, Friday 13 to Sunday 15 March.

Each day has two shifts:

- Morning: 9:00 to 13:00
- Afternoon: 13:00 to 17:00

Each shift needs two volunteers: one on the till, and one sorting boxes and refilling the tables.

The hall key is collected at 8:45, so every morning shift needs one key holder. The key holders this year are Ana Silva and Tom Reid.

Nobody should do more than two shifts.
